acceptance_criteria: cargo build succeeds with and without --features mdn; no mdn symbols leak into default build; register_mdn_handlers requires both MailBackend + MdnBackend bounds at compile time
description: Wire the mdn feature flag in Cargo.toml for jmap-mail-types and jmap-mail-server, and expose register_mdn_handlers in lib.rs.
design:
jmap-mail-types/Cargo.toml: add mdn = [] to [features].

jmap-mail-server/Cargo.toml: add mdn = ["jmap-mail-types/mdn"] to [features].

jmap-mail-server/src/lib.rs additions (behind cfg(feature=mdn)):
  pub mod mdn;
  pub const JMAP_MDN_URI: &str = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:mdn";
  pub use mdn::{MdnBackend, handle_mdn_send, handle_mdn_parse};
  pub fn register_mdn_handlers<B, C>(dispatcher: &mut Dispatcher<C>, backend: Arc<B>)
    where B: MailBackend + MdnBackend + 'static, C: Clone + Send + 'static

Registers exactly 2 method names: MDN/send, MDN/parse.

Note: unlike most JMAP methods, MDN/send triggers an implicit Email/set for $mdnsent stamping. The handler calls into MailBackend directly for the email update — so the generic bound requires BOTH MailBackend and MdnBackend.

Update crate-level doc comment to list the mdn feature and its 2 method names.

No /get, /set, /query, /changes — MDN has no stored object type.
title: mdn: feature flag wiring + register_mdn_handlers
